what: T1XFER final: 3 of 9 adopted, two rank points, ~$3.79 of credit

refused.e14: +0.2669 AUC but MPPE 6.06 -> 16.96, rank-neutral if taken

the_distribution_is_what_matters: Three adoptions of +0.385, +0.209 and +0.043 against six refusals. +0.637 of summed AUC over nine clips tried is +0.021 on the entry mean. The returns are heavy-tailed, which is why both of my projections were wrong: the optimistic one and then the pessimistic revision I made twenty minutes before e05 came in at five times it.
five_refuted_selection_ideas: donor-target size (registered as a prediction and refuted by it)
any projection of the per-clip rate
what_i_would_tell_the_next_person: Run it on everything eligible and do not try to pick. The rule's MPPE clause makes clips with tight shipped MPPE structurally ineligible, which narrows 30 clips to about 9, and inside those nine nothing predicts the outcome. At $0.50 a clip and a heavy tail, breadth beats cleverness -- I spent more analysis on selection than selection could ever have saved.
